summary:
Our project aims to make the exploration of the Moon and Mars more accessible by identifying Earth locations with similar geological, environmental, and surface traits. Since traveling there is challenging and costly, we built an interactive educational website without AI. It features six locations: three resembling the lunar environment and three mirroring Mars.
  
​Each location has a dedicated page detailing its geological and environmental features. Visitors can explore independently and participate in interactive missions via Google Forms, featuring quizzes and open-ended questions. These activities reinforce knowledge, strengthen scientific thinking, and encourage curiosity.​Our main goal is to turn complex space information into an engaging, interactive learning experience. By bridging Earth's challenges with the Moon and Mars, we hope to inspire curiosity and help students and researchers take a step closer to understanding space exploration.
details: Terra Cosmos is an interactive educational platform that helps people better understand the Moon and Mars by exploring similar geological and environmental conditions on Earth. Since conducting research directly on the Moon and Mars is extremely difficult, costly, and not always possible, we aim to learn about these worlds by studying comparable environments on our own planet. Our team spent a considerable amount of time researching six different locations on Earth that share similar characteristics with the Moon and Mars. We collected, examined, and organized scientific data to create detailed educational content. This allows visitors to discover not only these unique environments but also how studying them contributes to space exploration.Our website is divided into two main sections: The Moon and Mars. Visitors can choose a section, explore its three locations, and discover scientific information through detailed pages. At the end of each location, interactive quizzes help them evaluate their understanding, reinforce what they have learned, and develop their own ideas through open-ended questions.Terra Cosmos makes space science more accessible by helping visitors gain scientific knowledge, develop critical thinking skills, and reinforce what they learn through interactive quizzes. It also helps them better understand the geological and environmental characteristics of the Moon and Mars by exploring similar environments on Earth. In this way, it inspires curiosity about space exploration and makes learning more engaging, enjoyable, and memorable.We developed Terra Cosmos using Google Sites to create and publish our website, Google Forms to design interactive quizzes, and Canva to prepare visual designs and project materials. We also used computers and internet access to conduct research and collect scientific information, including data and findings from NASA’s research and missions, to support our educational content.The creativity of Terra Cosmos lies in transforming the idea of studying Earth environments similar to those on the Moon and Mars into an interactive learning experience. By connecting six unique locations on Earth to these celestial bodies, we allow visitors to create their own journey of discovery. We combine scientific research, visual content, location-based exploration, and interactive quizzes to offer an original and engaging alternative to traditional learning methods.Our team considered geological similarities, environmental conditions, and scientific significance when selecting the six locations. We examined features such as rock formations, craters, volcanic structures, extreme temperatures, cold, dryness, and ice to understand how these environments could contribute to our knowledge of the Moon and Mars. We also evaluated each location’s research potential and educational value. Our goal was not simply to choose places that look similar, but to identify scientifically valuable environments that can help us better understand other worlds.
